title: Turbulent buoyancy-influenced upflow in a heated vertical circular pipe

reference.citation: Upflow turbulent mixed convection heat transfer in vertical pipes (1998), International Journal of Heat and Mass Transfer, 41(24), 4037-4054
reference.measurements_policy: Transcribe exact pipe diameters, Reynolds, Grashof, heating, fluid properties, temperatures, and errors from original tables before constructing cases. No guesses.

physics.geometry: vertical circular pipe (not a differentially heated plane channel)
physics.flow: upward, forced to buoyancy-aided mixed convection
physics.boundary_conditions: Original wall heating and inlet/outlet profiles must be frozen from the experiment
physics.dimensionless: Re=Ub*D/nu, Pr=nu/alpha, Gr=g*beta*DeltaT*D^3/nu^2, Ri=Gr/Re^2 with documented reference temperature and length D

qoi: velocity and temperature profiles where measured
